xyr23gvw.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
xyr23gvw.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
xyr23gvw.sourceDescription: This Slim Christmas Tree with LED Light is a modern seasonal décor piece that seamlessly fits into compact living spaces, bringing festive spirit wherever it's displayed. Accessible and versatile, it's suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a delightful visual appeal through its cone-shaped stature and warm lighting. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this Christmas tree offers a realistic appearance and robust durability, perfect for supporting decorations and lights year after year. Combined with a metal base for added stability, it ensures the tree stands tall and secure without wobbling, enhancing its overall longevity and sturdiness, making it a reliable choice for holiday decorating. Included Components: Equipped with intricate strands of decorative LED string lights, the tree emits a warm white glow, creating a cozy ambiance. These lights are powered via a USB connection, providing versatile power options and making it ideal for various setups whether near a power outlet or connected to portable power banks, ensuring seamless integration into your festive settings. Features /Function /Design: Tailored for modern homes, this tree's slim design is perfect for those seeking a space-efficient solution. Its simple yet elegant construction allows it to fit neatly against walls, corners, or even tabletops, maximizing space while bringing a touch of nature. The modern style harmonizes with a variety of interior décors, enhancing your home's festive presentation. Recommended Uses: Whether displayed in a living room, garden, or terrace, this tree is perfectly suited for creating holiday cheer in any environment. Its elegant lighting effect makes it a superb choice for evening gatherings, fostering a warm and inviting atmosphere for family and guests during the festive season. Care &Maintenance: To protect your decorative investment, place a cover over the tree when not in use to shield it from dust and potential damage. This simple precaution will help maintain the tree's appearance and functionality year after year, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your holiday tradition. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and solid pine wood Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 77 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Durable Decorative with pine cones, Lifelike branch tips, Real wood trunk Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 465 Number of pine cones: 45 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
